offering_description.value: Blue Bird sells full-size school buses to public school districts, private schools and student transportation contractors. It builds buses with diesel, gasoline, propane and battery-electric powertrains and sells buses and replacement parts primarily through dealers.

primary_products.value: Type C conventional school buses; Type D transit-style school buses; school bus replacement parts

customer_segment.value: B2G: Public school districts and government fleet buyers; B2B: Private schools, student transportation contractors and school bus dealers

end_markets.value: K–12 student transportation; school bus fleet maintenance

revenue_model.value: product sales: New school buses and replacement parts

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Builds school buses from chassis, body and powertrain components for dealers and fleet buyers; distributor: Sources and supplies replacement parts to dealers serving school bus fleets

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: Conventional and transit-style school buses across multiple powertrains, plus replacement parts

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Independent school bus dealers supplying new buses and replacement parts; direct sales: Select fleet and government accounts

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: School bus manufacturing is subject to federal motor vehicle safety standards and EPA emissions rules.

notes: The current extent of sales outside the United States and Canada is uncertain.
